mutations.name: skip-receipt-check
mutations.why: A stale receipt can be acknowledged.

mutations.name: skip-connection-fence
mutations.why: The target commits after the original connection was lost.

mutations.name: replay-consumed-receipt
mutations.why: A second native validation can consume an already consumed receipt.

mutations.name: accept-forged-final-answer
mutations.why: The target accepts a response with the wrong nonce or view.
mutations.search: pc = "answer" /\ live /\ connGen = First /\ reply = <<challenge, handle>>

mutations.name: drop-view-generation-fence
mutations.why: An old commit can detach a replacement view.
mutations.search: handle = chosen /\ incarnation[chosen] = receiptInc /\ incarnation["targetCore"] = First /\ chosen \in attached
mutations.replace: handle = chosen /\ incarnation["targetCore"] = First /\ chosen \in attached

mutations.name: drop-target-core-generation-fence
mutations.why: An old commit can be replayed after the target core restarts.
mutations.search: handle = chosen /\ incarnation[chosen] = receiptInc /\ incarnation["targetCore"] = First /\ chosen \in attached
mutations.replace: handle = chosen /\ incarnation[chosen] = receiptInc /\ chosen \in attached

mutations.name: drop-final-safety-check
mutations.why: A dirty or busy view can be committed after final authorization.

mutations.name: detach-on-refusal
mutations.why: A refused local close detaches the view.

mutations.name: report-partial-as-closed
mutations.why: Cleanup failure is reported as a confirmed close.
mutations.search: outcome' = IF cleanup.up = "confirmed" /\ cleanup.local = "confirmed" THEN "Closed" ELSE "partial"

mutations.name: ack-before-host-exit
mutations.why: The last hosted execution may still be running when the leave is acknowledged.

mutations.name: local-close-before-exit
mutations.why: A last local execution is reported settled before its exit wait completes.
mutations.search: IF ~ok THEN "failed" ELSE IF waitExit THEN "waiting" ELSE "confirmed"

mutations.name: stop-other-execution
mutations.why: Closing this view stops the other execution.

mutations.name: remove-other-saved-record
mutations.why: Closing this view deletes the other saved record.

mutations.name: unknown-reported-closed
mutations.why: A hub call with unknown outcome is falsely reported as closed.
